# m.futures.contracts

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Futures contracts: the specification of every listed contract.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.futures.contracts(symbols=None, *, product_code=None, as_of=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol` and `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Only these contracts; None, the default, lists every contract. `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| `product_code` | Only contracts of this product (`"ES"`) or these (`["ES", "NQ"]`); None for every product. A table of codes, in a `ProductCode` column, reads each code as if passed alone; a live one is followed by `fetch()` and re-read by each `poll()` cycle. |
| [`as_of`](README.md#as_of) | The day whose specifications to list; None for today. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Such as `"ticker"`; the endpoint sorts by `product_code`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | Needs `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"active": True}` or `{"last_trade_date_gte": "2026-01-01"}`. Keys: `active`, `first_trade_date`, `first_trade_date_gt`, `first_trade_date_gte`, `first_trade_date_lt`, `first_trade_date_lte`, `last_trade_date`, `last_trade_date_gt`, `last_trade_date_gte`, `last_trade_date_lt`, `last_trade_date_lte`, `provider_id`, `provider_product_id`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`, `type`, `type_any_of`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Contracts (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Futures Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Futures Starter | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Futures Developer | Updated daily, 5 years |
| Futures Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business CME | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business CBOT | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business NYMEX | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business COMEX | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The ticker for the contract." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `Active` | boolean | Whether or not a given contract was tradeable at the given point in time. Active is true when (first_trade_date <= date <= last_trade_date) and false otherwise. |
| `Date` | String | The day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose point-in-time state the row describes: whether the contract was tradeable that day (`active`) and its days to maturity from it. |
| `DaysToMaturity` | long | The number of calendar days between the 'date' and the contract's final settlement date. |
| `FirstTradeDate` | String | The first day on which the contract was tradeable. |
| `GroupCode` | String | An identifier used to identify logical groups of products. The group_code is only populated for contracts listed for trading on CME Globex. |
| `LastTradeDate` | String | The last day on which the contract was tradeable. |
| `MaxOrderQuantity` | long | The maximum order quantity. |
| `MinOrderQuantity` | long | The minimum order quantity. |
| `Name` | String | The name of this contract. |
| `ProductCode` | String | The identifier for the contract's product. |
| `ProviderId` | String | A unique identifier for the contract assigned by the data provider. Note that this value is null for historical data (pre-2025-03-12). |
| `ProviderProductId` | String | A unique identifier for the product to which a contract, or contracts, belongs. Note that this value is null for historical data (pre-2025-03-12). |
| `SettlementDate` | String | The date on which this contract settles. |
| `SettlementTickSize` | double | The tick size for settlement. |
| `SpreadTickSize` | double | The tick size for spreads. |
| `TradeTickSize` | double | The tick size for trades. |
| `TradingVenue` | String | The trading venue (MIC) for the exchange on which this contract trades. |
| `Type` | String | The type of contract, one of 'single' or 'combo'. Leaving this filter blank will query for contracts where type is 'single', 'combo' or empty. This field only exists on contracts as of 2025-03-12 and later. It will be null when date < 2025-03-12. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
